scope: Frozen local measurements; elapsed encoding times are single runs, not controlled repeated benchmarks. No runtime decode, network, FPS or texture-memory improvement is inferred.

global.adoption: Global offline aggregate only; dimensions, pixels, frame timing and action/gaze strips unchanged. Encoded bytes can differ with codec/platform.

waiting.adoption: None. Quality 100 saved only 16 bytes; preserve action iteration speed. No blanket quality change.

reproduce: python tools/measure_lossless_encoding.py; python tools/measure_lossless_encoding.py --baseline. Reads current decoded pixels, writes only work/. Reproduction elapsed times and codec-specific bytes may differ.
